what: Research-harness decode throughput of the AiiStream prefetch engine vs direct on-demand streaming (the same comparison scripts/bench.py makes), measured 2026-09-28 during development.
important: The lab harness that produced these numbers is not included in this repository. scripts/bench.py measures the shipped engine path.

Measured with the build from before the seeded-sampling fix. A later paired A/B in the same harness measured the fixed engine against this build: +1.45% median, 5 of 8 pairs faster, i.e. no measurable speed change (evidence/production_checks_2026-09-29.json).
The harness generation loop and estimator differ from scripts/bench.py; on the same machine the shipped path measures about 12 tok/s. The cause of the gap is not yet identified.
Warm file cache. Absolute speed depends on free RAM; the same build measured 11.5-15.0 tok/s on different days. Paired gains are the reliable figure.

setup.estimator: decode rate over steps 16..n-1 of each generation; paired, alternating order, one process; 1 warm-up round excluded

held_out.note: prompts not used during development; natural end-of-sequence allowed; token IDs and lengths identical in every pair
